T: Back on the water. Bring coconuts.
D: Moana sails out with a new crew to break a storm god's curse and reconnect the islands.
P: Serve the snacks when the Kakamora come paddling up.
S: Prawns dipped in egg and shredded coconut, fried at 180C until golden, with sweet chilli and lime sauce.
Taro sliced thin and fried at 170C until crisp, tossed with sea salt and a little chilli.
Motunui chilli lime fruit with coconut

Pineapple, mango and papaya wedges squeezed with lime, dusted with chilli salt and toasted coconut, with halved passionfruit to spoon over. Toast 40g shredded coconut in a dry pan until golden, then cool. Cut half a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into wedges and lay on a big platter with 3 halved passionfruit. Grind 1 tsp sea salt with 1/2 tsp chilli flakes and 1 tsp sugar. Squeeze the juice of 2 limes over the fruit, sprinkle with the chilli salt and scatter with the coconut.
M: the crew's long voyage across the ocean
Snapper fillets marinated in coconut milk, lime and chilli, wrapped in banana leaves and grilled, with coconut rice.
the welcome feast back home on Motunui

Pork shoulder rubbed with salt, garlic and brown sugar, slow roasted in banana leaves until it pulls apart, with charred pineapple and coconut slaw. Rub a 2kg pork shoulder with 2 tsp salt, 4 crushed garlic cloves and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Wrap in banana leaves, then foil, and roast at 150C for 5 hours. Pull apart with forks and toss in the juices. Grill 8 pineapple rings until charred. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 3 tbsp coconut cream, the juice of 1 lime and coriander. Serve together.
W: Coconut milk and sugar thickened with cornflour, set in cups, topped with mango and toasted coconut. Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 5 tbsp cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy. Pour into cups and chill for 3 hours until set. Top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut before serving.
K: Pua the pig, who gets left on the beach at Motunui

Coconut water, fresh pineapple and lime blended with ice into a frosty crush, topped with a pineapple wedge and a paper umbrella. Blend 500ml chilled coconut water, 300g fresh pineapple chunks, the juice of 1 lime, 2 tbsp honey and 2 cups of ice until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 glasses or hollowed coconut shells. Garnish each with a pineapple wedge and a mint sprig and serve straight away with straws.

s.how: Peel 500g green prawns, leaving tails on. Dip in beaten egg, then press into shredded coconut mixed with panko. Fry at 180C for 2 minutes until golden. Stir lime juice into sweet chilli sauce and serve for dipping.

Peel 600g taro and slice very thin on a mandoline. Rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until crisp and pale golden. Toss straight away with sea salt flakes and a pinch of chilli flakes. Serve in a woven bowl.

m.note: the crew's long voyage across the ocean
m.how: Marinate 4 snapper fillets in coconut milk, lime juice and chopped red chilli for 20 minutes. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook jasmine rice in more coconut milk with salt. Serve the fish in its leaf.

w.how: Whisk 800ml coconut milk, 100g sugar and 5 tbsp cornflour over low heat until thick and glossy. Pour into cups and chill for 3 hours until set. Top with diced mango and toasted shredded coconut before serving.
